Author: Michiru Tsukikage; pistolero-git (fork)
Name: Crucible SUX Leveler
Description: Crucible SUX Leveler is a fork of Crucible SUX with a carry-leveling team mode and improved beast rank and EXP tracking. Uses AutoDuty to automate Crucible boards. Unattended automation is against the game terms of service.
Punchline: Crucible SUX fork with beast carry-leveling and direct rank/EXP tracking.
